title: WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame: one app for a game, still in beta, still your API key
friendlyTitle: OhMyGame is a beta app for making a game with your own AI key
summary: OhMyGame is an open-source desktop studio for making a game with an agent. The agent works on a canvas of docs, art, and models, then builds and playtests the game. It supports more than 40 model providers, and the keys stay on the machine. Desktop downloads are macOS on Apple silicon and Windows. It gained about 200 stars on GitHub's daily trending list, with about 2,000 in total. The license is Apache-2.0. The app is in beta.
friendlySummary: OhMyGame is an open-source desktop app for making a game with an AI agent. The agent can design, build, and playtest the game in one place. You bring your own model key, and the key stays on your computer. Downloads are for Apple-silicon Macs and Windows. It gained about 200 stars today and has about 2,000 in total. It is still in beta.
whyItMatters: Use it when you want one place to describe a browser game, generate the assets, and publish a link, without a per-run credit system. Linux and Intel Mac builds are still on the roadmap. Expect rough edges. Publishing a public link needs an OhMyGame account. Making the game locally does not.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it if you want to describe a browser game and get a shareable link without paying the app for each run. Linux is not supported yet. Expect rough edges. You can make the game locally without an account. Publishing the link needs one.
